title: Now compatible: Nintendo Switch and Fire TV Vega OS | VirtualPyTest
description:
VirtualPyTest now drives a Nintendo Switch, and Fire TV on its new operating system, Vega OS. On the Switch, VirtualPyTest acts as the game controller: it moves through the Home menu, launches Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 and lets its intro play, then switches to Super Kirby Clash, where button presses still work inside the game. Fire TV was already supported; now its new system Vega OS is too. The remote appears on screen: into YouTube, search, and a video plays, driven the way any viewer would.

Video on the Fire TV: Big Buck Bunny, (CC) Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0.

Open source & free
